title: Almost excellent
body:
Love it a lot and it has replaced me the need for  separate to do, calendar and reminder apps.
However, please:

1. Curent widgets aren't well designed and inconsistent in design with outlook's. 
    Why is there only "My Day" single unit widget, where's the option to choose other lists? Why it wastes so much space and only shows one task?
    Double unit wide widget, again, why so much wasted space with only 2 tasks? Do you really need a header that big? Does "X more" line really has to occupy more space than a single task?
     Same goes for outlook's widgets, they're just empty space. You already have weather info for each day, why not have it in the widget too for example? Why not add a large combined outlook calendar/to do widget? So I have my date, today's tasks, scheduled events and weather in one place. I'd love to have one 2x2 widget on my main page with all the info I need readily available. And 4x2 on my iPad. 

2. Please look into finding a way to integrate Edge's collections feature, it'd be amazing to use them for gathering material, and To Do for plannning.

3. There's not much reason for To Do to be a separate app if I use Outlook, add it there as an optional tab, like you have it in your browser extension. Plus combo widgets, I beg you.

4. For groceries list, please consider adding OCR functionality. Many people keep their grocery lists on the fridge, simply scanning it with To Do would be such a life changer.
